scope: Current source-bound functional failure with explicit public timing.
rule: Use the current binding. Decompose initial/reset/edge/enable/state/output; width only if relevant. For EACH rule use exactly SPECIFIED, UNSPECIFIED, AMBIGUOUS or NOT_OBSERVED, never prose or invented requirements. Compare public spec and current RTL with bound feedback; one primary hypothesis, minimal edit_dut, then verify_rtl. Put one inert line comment SKILL01_SUMMARY: JSON containing rules (six keys above, exact enum values), spec_quote, rtl_quote, hypothesis, action, limitations. Quotes MUST be exact contiguous substrings including whitespace: JSON-escape newlines; do not combine fragments. The existing Host records verification outcome and unresolved failures.
limitations: Only authorized spec, DUT, current diagnostics and bounded feedback/history. Unknown rules stay unknown. No oracle, past answers, exact cycle/expected-actual or proven cause inferred. No blanket initial/always_ff ban. One registered tool per response; edit then verify; only Host determines PASS.
